answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 852 Country: United States of America Title: If a certain invidual (zaid) believed in the tahreef of the Quran, and other person (xyz) doesnt belief in the kufar of zaid, and still hold him in high regard and think of him as a great person, does xyz also become a kafir? Question: If a certain invidual (zaid) believed in the tahreef of the Quran, and other person (xyz) doesnt belief in the kufar of zaid, and still hold him in high regard and think of him as a great person, does xyz also become a kafir? Answer ID: 852 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 977=713/H) Are people aware of his false beliefs or not? Also, for what reason they hold him in high regard and respect him i.e. for political and worldly matters or for his beliefs and religion? Please, enclose their statements with your question, then only we can have a say. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
